page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; an engraved device (woodcut of a female figure with banner and coats of arms) in the middle, no text blocks beside it. No margin notes.
page.notes: The engraving shows a standing female figure holding a staff and flag, with a banner reading "GELRO ZVTPHANI" and "...ADIVM" partly visible, flanked by coats of arms and a lion/animal figure at the base. The banner letters are partly illegible in the scan. Handwritten "1." in the top right corner is not transcribed. The title lines "Libris octo" and "Apostolicarum" are hyphenated across the line as printed; the "ct" ligature and "Ex Officinâ" are as printed.
